g.text: ✔ IMAP + SMTP: dry run by default; --send replies once, in-thread, only to the allowed and authenticated sender
✔ IMAP: a refused reply is not recorded (retried next pass); a wrong password is ok:false without the password
✔ --seed records what is due without replying; maxPerPass caps a burst
✔ plain TCP is refused to anything but a loopback host
✔ Composio Connect (ck_ key): lists mail from the allow-list, replies in the thread to the sender, labels it
✔ Composio: an error that echoes the key is redacted; a project key goes to the REST API
✔ allow-list: exact addresses and exact domains only; display names are not addresses
✔ authentication: only the topmost Authentication-Results counts
✔ decide: future, undated and threadless mail is skipped; self is never answered
✔ template and headers: mail text cannot add lines or headers
✔ IMAP reader: literals split across chunks; ledger trims oldest first; settings validate
✔ structured template: bold headline, at most three bold-lead lines, grey footer; mail text is escaped
